name: Tsuruga (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tsuruga city emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Tsuruga, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 1952.

features.role: Tsuruga city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised pointed device
